maria: Heads-up — docsite CI is failing for /guides/ingest after my PR that added a small table + some inline HTML. Linkcheck is reporting missing anchors for headers that clearly exist in the file. Anyone seen this before? 🙏 alex: Hmm, yes. Mixing inline HTML and MDX can confuse the slug/heading parser. Can you paste the failing CI output? maria: CI output (trimmed): ``` Linkcheck: Broken fragment: /guides/ingest#ingest-options warning: reserved id detected for heading "Ingest options" error Command failed with exit code 1. ``` I ran `yarn docs:build && yarn docs:linkcheck` locally and see the same. The page definitely has `### Ingest options` below the table. kevin: Can you paste the MDX around the table? An unclosed HTML tag or an HTML block can shift parser positions and cause slug mismatches. maria: Snippet from docs/guides/ingest.mdx: ``` | Column | Type | Notes | |---|---:|---| | id | string | unique id |
Some extra note about rendering. ### Ingest options Details about options... ``` So yeah — I think that stray `
` might be it. alex: Yep — unclosed HTML will bork the MDX AST. Short fixes: close the tag, or move HTML out, or add an explicit header id: `### Ingest options {#ingest-options}` — that will force the slug Docusaurus uses. sam: Quick commands to reproduce locally: `yarn docs:build` then `node ./scripts/run-linkcheck.js docs/build` (we have a small wrapper). If you want a fast check: `npx markdown-link-check docs/guides/ingest.mdx` but our CI runs a fragment-aware checker. elaine: I can open a tiny PR to (1) close the stray tag, (2) add explicit header id to be safe, and (3) add a short CONTRIBUTING note about avoiding inline HTML in docs. @maria can you confirm file path? maria: file is `docs/guides/ingest.mdx` — thanks! docs-bot: CI update — build #4821 failed: linkcheck on /guides/ingest — Broken fragment /guides/ingest#ingest-options elaine: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 — diff excerpt: ``` -
-Some extra note about rendering. - -### Ingest options +
Some extra note about rendering.
+ +### Ingest options {#ingest-options} +Details about options... ``` Also added a CONTRIBUTING.md line: "Prefer markdown tables and avoid raw HTML in MDX; if HTML is necessary, ensure tags are closed." kevin: LGTM. Should we add a lint job to CI to catch unclosed tags or raw HTML? Maybe `remark-lint` plugin could help. sam: I'm experimenting with `remark-lint-no-html` + `remark-slug` locally. If that proves stable I'll open an ops PR to add a docs lint job. It runs fast. maria: Merged PR — CI passed after the fix. Thanks everyone :rocket: alex: Nice! :tada: elaine: Follow-up: I'm going to prototype the remark-based lint in a fork and post results in #devex next week. maria: Perfect — closing the loop. If anyone sees flaky link failures, ping me and I can re-run linkcheck locally before merging. :+1:
